svg.aria-label: The lit-review mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake agent: you confirm (stop); Literature strategist: each source confirmed by a live lookup (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme run: search theme 1 (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme runs: each other search theme, all at once (agent, only when needed); Session: each report read for work left undone (question); Script: each theme run's and merge job's DOIs and arXiv IDs resolved, one resolve per file (script); Literature strategist, resumed with the identifier check: titles resolved, strict: a failing identifier corrected or removed (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, merge jobs, started by the session at once: a leads job per theme run, the intersections and the venues, the first citation round (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, citation rounds started by the session over the merged core set: refs and cited-by in jobs of at most 40 works, until the citation loop closes, at most 8 (agent, only when needed); The citation loop does not close: another 8 rounds, or go on with the works named (stop); Literature strategist, merge run, after the merge jobs: removes the duplicates, runs the quality gates, writes the report around the annotations the session joins (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, synthesis start: the section Synthesis Analysis (agent, only when needed); Session: the strategist's report read for work left undone (question); Script: every entry resolved, no identifier or title under two keys, the cited keys equal to the .bib's (script); Session: the exclusions read; one on a failed lookup is work left undone (question); You review the sources, optional (stop); Script: each corrected or added entry's DOI or arXiv ID resolved again (script); A reference that cannot be confirmed (stop); Formatter: each target other than Markdown, the review's issues back to the merge run or the synthesis start (agent, only when needed).
